title.en: The One With the Trip to Madrid

description.es: Marta le dice a Pelayo que, solo porque la hayan dejado, no puede arruinar su propia vida y hacer daño a los demás. Decide interpretar el papel de esposa que se espera de ella por el bien de Pelayo. Para despejarse y, a la vez, asistir a las reuniones de negocios de Pelayo, decide irse a Madrid con Pelayo durante unos días.
description.en: Marta tells Pelayo that just because she was left, she cannot ruin her own life and harm others. She decides to play the role of the wife that is expected of her for Pelayo's sake. To both clear her head and attend Pelayo's business meetings, she decides to go to Madrid with Pelayo for a few days.
